Class ThemeDraft

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.themecreator.ThemeDraft
public final class ThemeDraft extends Object
Undoable authoring state for Theme Creator. One bulk edit is one undo step, regardless of how many controls it affects. The preview and exported document always use the same current state.

    • set

      public void set(ThemeDraft.Target target, String expression)
      Applies one color or palette reference. Bulk edits remove narrower overrides of that same property in the selected scope, so "all buttons" also updates previously customized buttons. Other properties and menus keep their overrides.
      Parameters:
      target - destination and property
      expression - hex color or $palette reference

    • reset

      public void reset(ThemeDraft.Target target)
      Removes a local override. This is the reset part of Cut; the clipboard keeps the previously resolved color. An inherited value stays inherited instead of being replaced with a guessed default.
      Parameters:
      target - override to remove

    • change

      private void change(ThemeDefinition next)
      Validates before modifying history. The first change in a gesture records its starting document; later drag samples replace the current draft without filling the undo stack.

    • install

      private void install(ThemeDefinition next)
      Restores an already validated history snapshot and advances the presentation revision so cached previews cannot retain old colors.

    • without

      private static List<ThemeDefinition.Rule> without(List<ThemeDefinition.Rule> rules, String role, String screen, String element)
      Removes only the selected property within the requested scope. Shared rules are split when necessary so sibling elements keep their original overrides.
